summary.text: Reggie Miller is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives for District 31, which comprises parts of Lenawee, Monroe, Washtenaw and Wayne counties.
Before the House she was a Van Buren Township trustee for three terms.

paragraphs.text: Miller worked for 20 years as a courier and documentation specialist for a local freight forwarder custom broker.
She earned an associate degree from Purdue University North Central Indiana and a bachelor's degree in business administration from Cleary University in Ann Arbor.
She also graduated from Michigan State University's Michigan Political Leadership Program.
Her legislative priorities include repealing the retirement tax, paid family leave, school funding and universal pre-K.
She is married and raised two children in the area.
